newsitem.title: USA: Memphis, Tenn., approves $385.8 million budget.
newsitem.headline: Memphis, Tenn., approves $385.8 million budget.

text.p: Tennessee's Memphis City Council has approved a $385.8 million operating budget for fiscal 1998, the Commercial Appeal said Wednesday.

For the fourth straight year, the budget avoids increasing property taxes. It includes $3.6 million to hire 110 additional police officers, boosts spending for youth programs and raises salaries by 5 percent for most city workers.
The budget for the year beginning July 1 was approved 12-0 Tuesday.
The council also approved a capital program calling for $107.2 million of spending to build a new library, a senior citizens' center and other projects.
